title: What to expect from Organization Security Requirements

question.author: member_298
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for organization security requirements?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Team Accounts documentation says: All organization accounts must enroll in two-factor authentication; this requirement took effect with CloudBox 2.1 and applies to every member, including guests. Organizations on Business and Enterprise plans can additionally enable SSO (SAML or OIDC), which centralizes sign-in but does not replace the 2FA requirement. Admins can audit devices and sessions from the admin console and remotely sign out a lost laptop. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
